question: What exalted beings or states may the practitioner attain through this practice?
premises: Divine maidens of the gods are mentioned
The practitioner may attain such a state
inference: The practitioner may come to be among divine maidens, Yakshas, and Vidyadharas.
uncertainties: Whether the practitioner becomes a Yaksha-Vidyadhara or gains their company is ambiguous.
plain_english: He may become associated with the divine maidens of the gods and with Yakshas and Vidyadharas.
